commandRisk.forkBomb: This command is a fork bomb.
commandRisk.destructiveDelete: This command deletes a directory tree outside the working directory.

commandRisk.recursiveDelete: This command deletes a whole directory tree.
commandRisk.gitPush: This command publishes commits to a remote.

commandRisk.downloadToShell: This command pipes a download straight into a shell.

settings.title: Settings
settings.comingSoonDescription: This section arrives with the step that owns it.

timeouts.intro: The supervisor checks every speaking agent once a second and colours it by how long it has been silent.
timeouts.stallHint: Silence for this long turns an agent orange. Informational only — nothing is interrupted.
timeouts.hardHint: Silence for this long aborts the turn, marks the message skipped and lets the round continue without it.
timeouts.toolHint: Budget for a single MCP tool call. Used from the step that adds tools.
timeouts.permissionHint: How long a permission prompt waits for you before it denies itself and tells the agent that nobody answered.
timeouts.perChat: A chat can override the hard timeout in its own group settings; these values apply everywhere else.
timeouts.legendWorking: Requesting, streaming or running a tool
timeouts.legendAway: Working, but silent for longer than the stall timeout
timeouts.legendOffline: Timed out, failing repeatedly, or its provider does not answer

mcp.emptyDescription: Add one so your agents have tools to call.
mcp.selectOrCreateDescription: Pick a server from the list to edit its command, environment and flags.

presets.everything: The reference server, for trying this out: echo and a handful of demo tools that touch nothing.
presets.sequential-thinking: A scratchpad for working through a problem step by step. Reaches nothing outside the chat.
presets.fetch: Fetches a web page and hands it to the agent as Markdown.
presets.brave-search: Web search through the Brave API. Needs an API key.
presets.git: Log, diff and status of a local repository, and it can stage and commit.
presets.filesystem: Reads and writes files under the directories in its arguments. Replace the example path first.
presets.github: Issues, pull requests, code search and commits. Needs a personal access token.
presets.slack: Reads channels and history and posts as the bot. Needs a bot token and a team id.
presets.notion: Reads and edits pages and databases in a workspace. Needs an integration token.
presets.playwright: Drives a real browser: open a page, click, type, read it back.
presets.custom: An empty form for any other server: type the command or the URL yourself.

mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameHint: Also the prefix its tools get, so agents can tell two servers apart.
mcp.sideEffectsHint: Turn this on when the server's tools write files, send messages or push commits. Those tools are attached to executor agents only; discussion agents get read-only tools, so several models cannot overwrite each other's work.

skills.intro: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md in it. Agents are shown only its name and description, and read the rest when they need it.
skills.emptyDescription: Import a folder that contains a SKILL.md to give your agents instructions they can reach for.
skills.selectDescription: Pick a skill from the list to read what your agents will be given.
skills.noFiles: This skill bundles no other files.
skills.warningMissingDescription: {{folder}} was skipped: its SKILL.md declares no description.
skills.warningUnreadable: {{folder}} was skipped: its SKILL.md could not be read.

providers.emptyDescription: Add one so your agents have a model to talk to.
providers.selectOrCreateDescription: Pick a provider from the list to edit its endpoint, key and models.
providers.name: Name
providers.apiKeyStored: A key is stored. Type a new one to replace it, or clear the field to remove it.
providers.keyUnreadable: This key was saved by a previous version of the app and cannot be read after the update. Paste it again.
providers.authUnavailable: Signing in is not available for this provider yet. Use an API key.
providers.signedOut: Not signed in. Witena signs in through the Anthropic CLI and keeps no token of its own.
providers.signedOutGoogle: Not signed in. Witena signs in through the Google Cloud SDK and keeps no token of its own. You need a Google Cloud project with the Generative Language API enabled and billing attached.
providers.antMissing: The Anthropic CLI is not installed. Install it, then sign in:
providers.gcloudMissing: The Google Cloud SDK is not installed. Install it, then sign in:

providers.noModels: No models yet. Fetch them from the endpoint or add one by hand.

updates.developmentBuild: This is a development build, so there is nothing to update.

developer.editorHint: Where a file path, a diff header or a file tool card opens when you click it.
developer.editorCommandHint: Run with {path} replaced by the quoted absolute path and {line} by the line number. Do not quote the placeholders yourself.
developer.sandboxHint: Commands the executor runs are wrapped in sandbox-exec so they can only write inside the chat’s folder and the temporary directories. Reading and the network are not restricted. Turn it off for a command that has to write elsewhere.

notices.agentSkipped: {{agent}} did not respond and was skipped this round
notices.allOffline: Every member of this chat is offline, so nobody answered. Retry one from the member list.
notices.noMentions: Nobody was mentioned, so no agent answered. Mention a member with @ to get a reply.
notices.maxRoundsReached: Reached the limit of {{max}} automatic rounds. Send a message to continue.
notices.runFailed: The run stopped after an internal error: {{message}}
notices.toolsUnsupported: {{agent}}'s model cannot use tools, so this reply was written without them
notices.sandboxUnavailable: sandbox-exec was not found on this machine, so the command ran without the write sandbox.
notices.contextTruncated: {{agent}} could not fit the whole conversation in its context window, so the {{dropped}} oldest messages were left out of its view
notices.materialsTruncated: {{agent}} could not fit every material in its context window, so {{omitted}} of them are listed by path instead; it can still read them with read_file
notices.handoff: Handed to {{agent}}: implement what the group decided, then report what changed
notices.handoffDeliver: Asked {{agent}} to write {{path}} now, from what the group decided
notices.consensus: Everyone agreed, so the discussion ends here and the conclusion follows.
notices.voteClosed: The vote is closed: every member answered once. Send a message to carry on.
